findings.summary: The reconcile scheduler's wake-file debounce changed from 2000 ms to 5000 ms. startScheduler now gets debounceMs: webhook.debounceMs, which defaults to 5000 (the webhook receiver's default). Before this change the scheduler used its own DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_MS = 2_000 (scheduler.ts:12). In cli-dispatch reconcile --watch every wake-file trigger now waits 5 s instead of 2 s even when the yaml sets no key. This breaks AC1 (code constants become the defaults).
